title: Dieemprie
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

StarterGui:SetCore("DevConsoleVisible", true)

local sound = Instance.new("Sound", workspace)
sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://100108743969782"
sound.Volume = 39
sound:Play()

local scrEnv = {
	print = print,
	warn = warn,
	error = error,
	Instance = Instance,
	Color3 = Color3,
	UDim2 = UDim2,
	Vector3 = Vector3,
	task = task,
	workspace = workspace,
	game = game,
	Players = Players,
	math = math,
	string = string,
	table = table,
	typeof = typeof,
	pcall = pcall
}

local function runCodeLocal(code)
	local f, err = loadstring("return function()\n"..(code or "").."\nend")
	if not f then
		warn(err)
		return false, err
	end
	local ok, func = pcall(f)
	if not ok then
		warn(func)
		return false, func
	end
	if setfenv then
		setfenv(func, scrEnv)
	else
		local env = {}
		for k,v in pairs(scrEnv) do env[k]=v end
		setmetatable(env, {__index = _G})
	end
	local ok2, err2 = pcall(func)
	if not ok2 then
		warn(err2)
		return false, err2
	end
	return true
end

local function injectRaw(code)
	local f, err = loadstring(code or "")
	if not f then
		warn(err)
		return false, err
	end
	if setfenv then
		setfenv(f, scrEnv)
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(f)
	if not ok then
		warn(res)
		return false, res
	end
	return true
end

local function showLocalMsg(parent, text)
	local w = Instance.new("TextLabel", parent)
	w.Size = UDim2.new(0,300,0,36)
	w.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-150,0.85,-18)
	w.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,230,0)
	w.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	w.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	w.TextSize = 16
	w.Text = text
	w.BorderSizePixel = 0
	task.delay(2, function() if w and w.Parent then w:Destroy() end end)
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "EEMPRIE hack"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local coverImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

titleLabel.TextSize = 20

titleLabel.Text = "Executor"
titleLabel.Parent = topBar

local serversideBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

local loadstringModeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

local minimizeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

minimizeButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1

minimizeButton.Parent = topBar

local leftPanel = Instance.new("Frame")

leftPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 134)
leftPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
leftPanel.Parent = mainFrame

local inputFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

inputFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
inputFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240,200,0)

local lineFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

local scriptBox = Instance.new("TextBox")

scriptBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 0)
scriptBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scriptBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
scriptBox.TextSize = 16
scriptBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
scriptBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
scriptBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
scriptBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
scriptBox.MultiLine = true
scriptBox.Parent = inputFrame

local lineNumbers = Instance.new("TextLabel")

lineNumbers.BackgroundTransparency = 1
lineNumbers.Font = Enum.Font.Code
lineNumbers.TextSize = 16
lineNumbers.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150)

lineNumbers.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
lineNumbers.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)

scriptBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	local lines = scriptBox.Text:split("\n")
	local s=""
	for i=1,#lines do s=s..i.."\n" end
	lineNumbers.Text=s
	inputFrame.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(0,0,0,#lines*20)
end)

local buttonFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
buttonFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,-40,0,50)
buttonFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,15,0,234)
buttonFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
buttonFrame.Parent = leftPanel

local names={"Execute","CLEAR","INJECT","RESERVE"}
local btns = {}
for i,name in ipairs(names) do
	local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size=UDim2.new(0,100,1,0)
	b.Position=UDim2.new(0,(i-1)*110,0,0)
	b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(230,180,0)
	b.Text=name
	b.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	b.Font=Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	b.TextSize=18
	b.Parent=buttonFrame
	btns[name]=b
end

local rightPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
rightPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 1, -128)
rightPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 134)
rightPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
rightPanel.Parent = mainFrame

local serversideToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
serversideToggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
serversideToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
serversideToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230,180,0)
serversideToggle.Text = "Send to Server"
serversideToggle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
serversideToggle.TextSize = 14
serversideToggle.Parent = rightPanel

local autorunToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
autorunToggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
autorunToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40)
autorunToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230,180,0)
autorunToggle.Text = "AutoRun: OFF"
autorunToggle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
autorunToggle.TextSize = 14
autorunToggle.Parent = rightPanel

local function findFirstRemoteEvent()
	for _,v in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			return v
		end
	end
	return nil
end

btns["Execute"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local code = scriptBox.Text or ""
	runCodeLocal(code)
	if autorunToggle.Tag == true then
		local evt = findFirstRemoteEvent()
		if evt then
			showLocalMsg(mainFrame, "RemoteEvent FINDEXE!")
			pcall(function() evt:FireServer(code) end)
			print("RemoteEvent FINDEXE! ->", evt:GetFullName())
		else
			showLocalMsg(mainFrame, "RemoteEvent not find ):")
			print("RemoteEvent not find ):")
		end
	end
end)

btns["CLEAR"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	scriptBox.Text = ""
end)

btns["INJECT"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	injectRaw(scriptBox.Text)
end)

btns["RESERVE"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local w=Instance.new("TextLabel",mainFrame)
	w.Size=UDim2.new(0,260,0,40)
	w.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-130,0.5,-20)
	w.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,230,0)
	w.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	w.Font=Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	w.TextSize=20
	w.Text="ERR"
	task.delay(2,function() if w then w:Destroy() end end)
end)

serversideToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local code = scriptBox.Text or ""
	local evt = findFirstRemoteEvent()
	if evt then
		showLocalMsg(mainFrame, "RemoteEvent FINDEXE!")
		pcall(function() evt:FireServer(code) end)
		print("RemoteEvent FINDEXE! ->", evt:GetFullName())
	else
		showLocalMsg(mainFrame, "RemoteEvent not find ):")
		print("RemoteEvent not find ):")
	end
end)

autorunToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if autorunToggle.Tag then
		autorunToggle.Tag = false
		autorunToggle.Text = "AutoRun: OFF"
	else
		autorunToggle.Tag = true
		autorunToggle.Text = "AutoRun: ON"
	end
end)

loadstringModeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	btns["INJECT"].Visible = true
end)

local target = "salmnusaod"
local ok,id = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(target) end)
if ok then
	local ok2,thumb = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(id,Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarThumbnail,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
	end)
	if ok2 then coverImage.Image = thumb end
end
